item.title: Thank You for Attending the 2025 City of Columbus Human Resources Conference!
item.description:
2025 City of Columbus Human Resources Conference

 

Thank you for attending the 2025 City of Columbus Human Resources Conference No Silos, Just Solutions: A Culture of Collaboration!

We hope you enjoyed a full day of learning, collaborating, and celebrating our shared mission.

Post-Conference Survey

Let’s make next year even better - together! Please take a moment to share your thoughts by completing the Post-Conference Survey by October 30, 2025. Click the link below or scan the QR code.

2025 Post-Conference Survey

2025 Service Project: CelebrateOne Diaper Drive

A special thank you to everyone who participated and donated to our 2025 Service Project allowing CelebrateOne to continue to give Columbus babies a healthy start.

item.title: 2025 City of Columbus Human Resources Conference is TODAY!
item.description:
2025 City of Columbus Human Resources Conference

 

The 2025 HR Conference is today, Wednesday, October 22, 2025, at Mitchell Hall on the Columbus State Community College Campus from 9:00 a.m. - 3:30 p.m. 

Our annual Human Resources Conference will bring together HR staff from across all departments for a day of learning, collaboration, and celebration of our shared mission.

Expect impactful sessions, expert speakers, and networking opportunities! 

This year's theme is:

No Silos, Just Solutions:

A Culture of Collaboration

 

2025 Conference Guidebook

Send this guidebook page link to your personal device to use throughout the day!

No printed copies of the guidebook will be provided; please print the PDF found under the "GUIDEBOOK" tab on the conference website in advance if you would like a printed copy.

This year your 2025 City of Columbus Human Resources Conference Guidebook is digital! Visit the conference webpage to view the guidebook and access additional information.

2025 City of Columbus Human Resources Conference Webpage

Parking Information

Parking will be in the surface lot of 12-S (located at the corner of Cleveland Ave. and Spring St.) with overflow in the Washington Ave. Parking Garage.

Parking Instructions

a. TEXT 93670 to (201) 379-2616
b. Enter license plate and state of vehicle; click “next.”
c. Choose length of stay (“HOURS”).
• NOTE: hours are in the middle column.
d. Enter name + email.
e. Use code HRCONFERENCE in the promo code area and click “apply.”

*Please note that these codes can only be used via text and will not work if a QR code in the lot is scanned.*


*Do NOT back into your parking spot.*

Venue Map (Inside)

2025 Service Project: CelebrateOne Diaper Drive

Bring unopened diapers to the conference or donate via the QR codes below to help CelebrateOne give Columbus babies a healthy start.
